sources.quote: o3-mini is our newest small reasoning model, providing high intelligence at the same cost and latency targets of o1-mini.
sources.supports: OpenAI documents o3-mini at the same cost and latency targets as o1-mini, consistent with the lower rate being official by o3-mini's 2025-01-31 snapshot.

notes: The available official documentation confirms the lower o1-mini rate now and ties that cost target to o3-mini (snapshot 2025-01-31), but neither source explicitly states o1-mini's historical rate or when it changed. Internet Archive pricing snapshots could not be retrieved (429), and OpenAI's announcement page extraction was blocked (403), so the classification and any earlier official price remain unresolved.
